description: Step 3 of 3: checks every picked model and dataset id live on its hub, drops the ones that are not there, flags licenses, gating, staleness and low use, sizes each model against the compute (fits, a stretch that fits only quantized, or cloud, with who hosts it), marks picks the search didn't turn up as from memory, names every hub a pick is on, shows what it found that wasn't picked, and returns the report to show the user. If nextAction is SEARCH_FIRST or RECALL_REPLACEMENTS, do what its instructions say and call again.

search.description: The part's last where_my_hug_search query, unchanged; none for a WRITE part

keywords.description: 1 to 3 single words a fitting model's name might hold, such as "ocr"

phrase.description: The job in a few words, as a model card would put it, such as "handwritten text recognition"

task.description: The Hugging Face task tag the job falls under, as the Hub's filters name it, such as "image-to-text" or "automatic-speech-recognition"

compute.description: The hardware it has to run or train on, such as "one 24 GB GPU" or "CPU only". Size flags take the first "N GB" in it as the memory a model must fit in

need.description: The ML need in plain words: what goes in, what should come out, and what it is for

recommendation.description: What to act on first: the one or two picks worth trying now and why (fit, license, use), then the ones to skip and why. Shown last, as "Start here"

name: where_my_hug_verify
title: Where my hug at? (checked live)
